abstract: It is extremely difficult to specify which pregnancy is responsible for gestational choriocarcinoma. Generally an antecedent pregnancy, directly preceding choriocarcinoma, is thought to be responsible for it. We have seen not a few cases of choriocarcinoma that had an obstetrical history of previous molar pregnancy preceding antecedent pregnancy. In such cases, responsibility not of the antecedent non-molar pregnancy but of the previous molar pregnancy is highly suspect in choriocarcinoma. In Niigata prefecture which has a population of 2.5 millions, we have reported 1,573 cases of total hydatidiform mole and 61 cases of choriocarcinoma in the past 12 years to the Regional Trophoblastic Disease Center. There were 8 cases of interrupted postmolar choriocarcinoma. The antecedent pregnancy was term delivery in 6 cases and abortion in 2 cases. It was of special interest to note that most of the interrupted postmolar choriocarcinoma were anteceded by term delivery with a previous history of hydatidiform mole. With the aid of statistics of pregnancy, delivery and trophoblastic disease in Niigata prefecture in the period of the survey, delivery with a previous history of hydatidiform mole was calculated to have 290 times as high risk of choriocarcinoma as that without a history of hydatidiform mole. Recently intraplacental choriocarcinoma with either living or, at times, stillborn baby has been reported occasionally. Most of the placenta reported in those cases showed no adverse effect on the growth of the fetus and no gross abnormality. Mostly intraplacental choriocarcinomatous lesion was detected incidentally or by minute histological examination of the placenta. From these results we emphasize the need to have a careful gross as well as microscopic examination of the placenta in case of a parturient with a previous history of hydatidiform mole and who has a higher risk for choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の原因となった妊娠を特定することは極めて困難である。一般に、絨毛癌の直前にある先行妊娠が原因と考えられている。われわれは、先行妊娠の前に胞状奇胎の既往があった絨毛癌を少なからず経験している。そのような場合、絨毛癌の原因は先行の非胞状奇胎妊娠ではなく、以前の胞状奇胎である可能性が高いと考えられる。新潟県（人口250万人）では、過去12年間に全胞状奇胎1,573例と絨毛癌61例を地域絨毛性疾患センターに報告してきた。このうち胞状奇胎後の中断性絨毛癌は8例であった。先行妊娠は正期分娩6例、流産2例であった。中断性胞状奇胎後絨毛癌の多くが、胞状奇胎の既往を伴う正期分娩の後に生じていたことは特に注目に値する。調査期間中の新潟県における妊娠、分娩、絨毛性疾患の統計を用いて計算すると、胞状奇胎の既往を伴う分娩は、既往のない分娩と比べて絨毛癌のリスクが290倍高いとされた。近年、生児または死産児を伴う胎盤内絨毛癌が時折報告されている。これらの報告で胎盤の多くは胎児発育への悪影響や肉眼的異常を示さなかった。胎盤内絨毛癌病変の多くは偶発的に、あるいは胎盤の詳細な組織学的検査により発見されている。これらの結果から、胞状奇胎の既往を有し絨毛癌のリスクが高い産婦では、胎盤の肉眼的検査と顕微鏡的検査を慎重に行う必要があることを強調する。
